item.title: WA demersal fishing ban: Shark fisher John Higham stages rooftop protest against bans at fisheries office
item.description: A Geraldton fisher who chained himself to the roof of the local fisheries office and swallowed the key has voluntarily ended his protest against the State Government’s demersal fishing bans.

item.title: Sporties’ Clint Yeates oversees commanding 190-run win over Bluff Point after notching up 23rd career century
item.description: The Geraldton Bendigo Bank Cricket League had no shortage of action, as two Sportsmans’ batters went berserk with the bat, while Chapman-Valley Northampton remain in the finals race after upsetting Wanderers.

item.title: Consumer Watch with Candice Evans: What to know about avoiding a holiday house horror
item.description: Staying in a holiday house can be like a home away from home. Just like with any product or service you buy, your rights are protected by Australian Consumer Law if things go wrong.

item.title: Relatives of Edith Cowan set to attend Geraldton unveiling of statue honouring political pioneer
item.description: Descendants of one of Geraldton’s most influential daughters, Edith Cowan, will attend the unveiling ceremony in Geraldton next week of a statue dedicated to the political trailblazer.

item.title: Geraldton MLA Kirrilee Warr to open round two of Local Champions Fund to help community groups
item.description: Geraldton MLA Kirrilee Warr is set to launch round two of her Local Champions Fund, providing a financial boost to community members and groups trying to make a difference.

item.title: Funding for regional traineeships a boost to education in Mullewa, Coorow and Dongara
item.description: Regional learning has received a funding boost, with Dongara and Mullewa community resource centres backed by the State Government to deliver in-person learning.

item.title: Geraldton’s Catholic population to mark Ash Wednesday in an unusual way
item.description: St Francis Xavier Cathedral’s congregation will take its Ash Wednesday service on the road for the first time, marking the beginning of Lent with a walk through town.

item.title: Geraldton Softball Association: Rams, Suiside storm to dominant victories in men’s top division
item.description: Rams and Suiside left their opponents with no answers to claim commanding victories, as other sides begin tying up loose ends with finals fast approaching

item.title: Geraldton Water Polo Association finals: Demons’ top sides trounce opponents to seal grand final place
item.description: Demons booked their place in both A-grade grand finals on Saturday afternoon, with dominant wins in the women’s and men’s semifinals of the Geraldton water polo season.

item.title: Rainfall brings summer spectacle as Greenough River breaks
item.description: Ex-tropical cyclone Mitchell might have been downgraded by the time it crossed the coast, but it brought enough rain that the Greenough River broke into the sea late Saturday afternoon.
